I am an old woman, and I have farmed this land since I was a girl. Money is tight, and the shop fertilizer is too expensive for this small plot, but I have cow manure from our animals that I will spread to give the maize strength. We will use the seed we saved from last year's harvest, and my children and grandchildren will help me clear, plant, weed, and harvest by hand, as we have always done, because we cannot pay workers and the rains have always been enough without irrigation.
